declaration.statement: Candidate evidence for the exact KubeEdge 1.18.0 to 1.19.0 keadm init change: legacy --profile version=<version> selector intent becomes external values-file handling; the target exposes --kubeedge-version.

limitations: Tag bindings, source bytes, digests, exact spans, attribution and semantic scope require independent review.
The proposed check applies only when an operator explicitly declares complete official upstream keadm init argv and the intended selector meaning; a version-like filename never proves legacy intent.
Legitimate external --profile values files, both selectors, defaults, partial or ambiguous argv, custom builds, other subcommands and other version pairs remain unresolved.
A scoped PASS only clears this legacy selector condition for explicit --kubeedge-version=v1.19.0 with --profile absent.
This packet does not inspect a file or cluster or establish installation, startup, runtime, whole-upgrade, signing, publication or support for other versions.

attribution.attribution: Bounded excerpts and immutable references to upstream KubeEdge source and release guidance; attribution and licensing require independent review.
